body: Remove 4 dead-candidate deterministic steps — GATED, low priority. Stage-2 census (stage2-census.md) found ZERO corpus firings across 4,131 files for: header_hint_measurement, header_hint_fallback, the legacy F3 hs_code emitter (feature_disambiguate path), and value_sharpen R21/R3 (coord gate). Removable as dead code, BUT zero-fire on a sample corroborates, does not prove dead — clear against the FULL multi-instrument map (corpus-honest gate + m-19 + gold-anchor) before deleting, per memory header-hint-deletion-blocked-multi-instrument. Cleanup only. DO NOT touch F6 (gain-heavy 43:2), the F5 float branch (live, 8 fires), or the bare header catchall (0048-inversion unobserved in 4,131 files) — Stage 2 cleared all three.

Ledger entry: legacy non-taxonomy label representation.alphanumeric.alphanumeric_id still emitted by hardcoded paths in crates/finetype-model/src/column.rs (~4479-4688). Cost >=1 gold column (scored as a miss vs representation.identifier.alphanumeric_id) and carries 686 ydf-gated corpus columns. Found during design of spec 2026-06-11-categorical-identifier-recall-retrain.
